## What happened?

Describe the problem and what you expected instead.

## How to reproduce

List the smallest reliable set of steps.

## Environment

Include browser, operating system, relevant configuration, and the commit or deployed version.

## Additional context

Add screenshots, logs with sensitive data removed, or other useful details.
